WITH mc_min AS (
    SELECT mc.movie_id,
           MIN(mc.note) AS note
    FROM movie_companies AS mc
    JOIN company_type AS ct
      ON ct.id = mc.company_type_id
     AND ct.kind = 'production companies'
    WHERE mc.note NOT LIKE '%(as Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer Pictures)%'
      AND (mc.note LIKE '%(co-production)%' OR mc.note LIKE '%(presents)%')
    GROUP BY mc.movie_id
),
top_rank_movies AS (
    SELECT mi_idx.movie_id
    FROM movie_info_idx AS mi_idx
    JOIN info_type AS it
      ON it.id = mi_idx.info_type_id
     AND it.info = 'top 250 rank'
    GROUP BY mi_idx.movie_id
),
movie_agg AS (
    SELECT mc.movie_id,
           MIN(mc.note) AS production_note,
           MIN(t.title) AS movie_title,
           MIN(t.production_year) AS movie_year
    FROM mc_min AS mc
    JOIN top_rank_movies AS trm
      ON trm.movie_id = mc.movie_id
    JOIN title AS t
      ON t.id = mc.movie_id
    GROUP BY mc.movie_id
)
SELECT MIN(production_note) AS production_note,
       MIN(movie_title) AS movie_title,
       MIN(movie_year) AS movie_year
FROM movie_agg
